national_news.title: Flash Floods Hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River Affecting Kailash Manasarovar Pilgrims
bullets: Severe flash floods struck the Bhote Koshi River in Nepal's Rasuwa region near the Tibet border, triggered by an earthquake-induced avalanche.
Over 100 Indian nationals and 37 NRIs heading for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra in Tibet were among nearly 500 missing persons.
The flood surged through Rasuwa, Dhading, Nuwakot, and Chitwan districts, damaging major bridge infrastructure across the region.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / BPSC / SSC - Bilateral & Regional Events

national_news.title: India Dispatches 10 Tonnes of HADR Material to Flood-Hit Nepal
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi communicated with Nepalese PM Balendra Shah, offering full support and solidarity during the flood disaster.
India dispatched 10 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) supplies along with essential medicines to Nepal.
Top Indian leadership, including President Droupadi Murmu and EAM Dr. S. Jaishankar, pledged full assistance for relief operations.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / BPSC - Disaster Relief & Bilateral Relations

national_news.title: Bihar Puts Six Districts on High Alert Following Nepal Flash Floods
bullets: Bihar placed six districts along the Gandak River basin—West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali—under heightened vigilance.
The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) deployed 9 teams in Bihar and 11 in Uttar Pradesh to prepare for potential river overflows.
Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary and Chief Secretary Pratyaya Amrit chaired high-level review meetings, with Union Home Minister Amit Shah assuring Central assistance.
national_news.exam_tag: BPSC Special Current Affairs - Disaster Preparedness

national_news.title: India and China Hold 25th Round of Special Representatives Boundary Talks in Beijing
bullets: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi co-chaired the 25th Round of Special Representatives (SR) Talks on the Boundary Question in Beijing.
Both sides agreed on eight points of consensus, advancing negotiations based on the 2005 Agreement on Political Parameters and Guiding Principles.
Key outcomes include establishing two additional military hotline channels, two extra border meeting points, and holding the Expert-Level Mechanism on Trans-border Rivers.

national_news.title: Onam Harvest Festival Celebrated Across Kerala
bullets: Onam is the major harvest festival of Kerala, celebrated to mark the arrival of the new harvest season and welcome the legendary King Mahabali.
Key cultural traditions of the festival include Ona Pookkalam (floral carpets), Ona Sadya (traditional feast), Vallam Kali (snake boat races), and traditional folk dances.
Special prayers and rituals were conducted across major temples in the state, including Sabarimala, Aranmula, and Guruvayur.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Highlights India's Economic Growth and Digital Ecosystem in Canada
bullets: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed the Indian business community in Toronto during a four-day official visit to Canada.
She emphasized India's structural economic transformation driven by rapid urbanisation, expanding capital markets, and a globally recognized digital financial infrastructure.
The visit focuses on enhancing fintech collaboration, trade linkages, and implementing the strategic bilateral agreement reached between PM Narendra Modi and Canadian PM Mark Carney.

national_news.title: PM Modi Reviews Infrastructure Projects and Quality Assurance at PRAGATI Meeting
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the monthly PRAGATI interaction covering six major projects in railway, road, and power sectors valued at over ₹30,000 crore across nine states.
PM Modi raised concerns over public project execution quality, questioning the efficacy of existing third-party audits and directing integrated project tracking.
The meeting also focused on cyber fraud prevention through targeted education campaigns for vulnerable groups and continuous training for enforcement officials.

national_news.title: India and Seychelles Discuss Bilateral MoU on Fisheries and Blue Economy Cooperation
bullets: Seychelles sought to fast-track an exclusive bilateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with India targeting fisheries, aquaculture, and blue economy development.

Discussions between Seychelles Minister Wallace Cosgrow and Indian Fisheries Secretary Abhilaksh Likhi covered marine research, AI in harvest management, tuna fisheries, and digital monitoring systems.
India highlighted its national achievements, including annual fish production of 19.7 million tonnes and seafood exports valued at USD 8.46 billion.

national_news.title: Regional Rural Banks Register Record Net Profit of ₹10,176 Crore in FY 2025-26
bullets: India's 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) achieved a record consolidated net profit of ₹10,176 crore in FY26, marking a 49% growth from ₹6,820 crore in the previous year.
The total business of RRBs crossed ₹13.5 lakh crore, with Gross NPAs dropping to 5.3%, Net NPAs to 2.1%, and Credit-Deposit ratio climbing to a historic high of 75.2%.
RRBs expanded rural outreach across 22,273 branches, adding over 54.98 lakh new Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts while meeting all Priority Sector Lending targets.

national_news.title: National Traders' Welfare Board Holds 100th Virtual Interaction Meeting
bullets: The National Traders' Welfare Board (NTWB), functioning under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, convened its landmark 100th Virtual Conference Interaction Meeting chaired by NTWB Chairman Sunil J. Singhi.

The initiative was formally launched during the 3rd Board meeting on July 11, 2024, following a decision taken in February 2024 under Union Minister Piyush Goyal to conduct weekly interaction sessions every Monday.

The structured virtual platform aims to disseminate information on central schemes, resolve grievances of retail traders, and connect small, medium, and large traders directly with government departments.

national_news.title: IMA Issues Health Advisory on H1N1 Surge and Warns Against Antibiotic Misuse
bullets: The Indian Medical Association (IMA) issued a public health advisory regarding the seasonal spike in Influenza A (H1N1) cases, emphasizing that the infection is self-limiting and requires no panic.
Strictly cautioned against over-the-counter consumption of antibiotics like azithromycin, amoxicillin-clavulanate, and cefixime, stressing that antibiotics do not treat viral infections.
Advised public adoption of preventive measures such as frequent handwashing, respiratory hygiene, and mask usage in crowded spaces.

national_news.title: Home Minister Sets One-Year Target for 100% Implementation of New Criminal Laws
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the National Security Strategies Conference (NSSC) in New Delhi, setting a 100% implementation deadline for the three new criminal justice laws within one year.
The goal is to ensure case resolution up to the Supreme Court level within three years and increase the overall conviction rate by 25%.

Key initiatives outlined include the 'Narcotics Control Vision Document 2026-2029' based on the 'Detect, Disrupt, Destroy' strategy, a quadrilateral border security approach, and integrating platforms like CCTNS, ICJS, NatGrid, and NAFIS.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / Civil Services Polity & Internal Security

bihar_news.title: Gandak River Flood Threat Prompts Precautionary Measures in UP-Bihar Border Districts
bullets: The Central Water Commission (CWC) issued an alert for the Gandak river system following severe upstream flooding in Nepal's Trishuli river.
Authorities in Bihar opened all 36 gates of the Valmikinagar Barrage in West Champaran as a precautionary measure to manage the flood surge.
The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) deployed 20 teams across the region, placing 9 teams in Bihar and 11 in Uttar Pradesh.

bihar_news.title: Nepal Flash Floods Trigger High Alert in Bihar's Gandak River Basin
bullets: Flash floods originating from Nepal's Bhote Koshi and Trishuli rivers surged into the Narayani River, which enters Bihar as the Gandak River at Valmikinagar in West Champaran.
All 36 gates of the Gandak Barrage at Valmikinagar were opened, discharging approximately 1.50 lakh cusecs of water to manage the flood wave.
Special vigilance was ordered across vulnerable northern Bihar districts, including West Champaran, East Champaran, Gopalganj, Saran, Muzaffarpur, and Vaishali.

bihar_news.title: GLOF Event at Tibet-Nepal Border Prompts NDRF Alert in Bihar and UP
bullets: A Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) near the Tibet-Nepal border led to a sudden surge in the Trishuli River, threatening downstream areas along the Gandak River basin.
The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) positioned 9 teams in Bihar (including West Champaran and Muzaffarpur) and 11 teams in Uttar Pradesh for flood rescue operations.
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and the Central Water Commission (CWC) are actively monitoring the downstream movement of floodwaters near the India-Nepal border.

bihar_news.title: MoSPI Reports ₹3.40 Lakh Crore Cumulative Cost Overrun in 1,775 Central Infrastructure Projects
bullets: According to a report by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI) for July 2026, 1,775 ongoing central infrastructure projects (worth over ₹150 crore each) incurred a total cost overrun of ₹3,40,504 crore.

The cumulative revised cost for these monitored projects reached ₹37,10,642 crore against an original estimate of ₹33,70,138 crore, with total expenditure standing at ₹19.26 lakh crore (51.91% of revised cost).

The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways accounts for the largest share with 993 projects (56% of total) worth ₹9.62 lakh crore, followed by the Ministry of Railways with 190 projects worth ₹6.38 lakh crore.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Unveils ₹70,000-Crore Expansion Plan for 126-km Ganga Marine Drive
bullets: The Bihar government announced an infrastructure plan to expand Patna's J.P. Ganga Path into a 126-km Ganga Marine Drive with an estimated investment of ₹70,000 crore.
The financial structure follows a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, with ₹20,000 crore contributed by the state government and ₹50,000 crore raised via private investment.
The project aims to transform the southern bank of the Ganga river into an economic corridor and significantly improve regional road connectivity.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Appoints Ex-CJ of Orissa HC as Administrator of Bihar Cricket Association
bullets: The Supreme Court appointed Justice Chakradhari Sharan Singh, former Chief Justice of the Orissa High Court, as the administrator of the Bihar Cricket Association (BCA).
The decision follows recommendations in a report by BCA Ombudsman Justice L Nageswara Rao, which highlighted electoral discrepancies in the 2025 BCA elections.
The administrator is tasked with conducting a verification exercise across District Cricket Associations (DCAs), recalibrating the electoral college, and overseeing fresh elections.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Flags Off 4,700 Two-Wheelers Under 'Police Didi' Initiative
bullets: On Raksha Bandhan, Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary launched three welfare initiatives, including the 'Police Didi' campaign.
The state government handed over 4,700 scooters and motorcycles to female police personnel ('Police Didi') to improve patrolling and safety for women and students.
The initiative focuses on strengthening community outreach, proactive surveillance, and rapid response mechanisms across urban and rural Bihar.

bihar_news.title: NITI Aayog Report Highlights Need for Job-Linked Skilling in Higher Education
bullets: NITI Aayog released a report titled 'Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat 2047', pointing out weak job linkages in traditional BA, BSc, and BCom degree courses.
The report advocates for the expansion of Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programmes (AEDP) to bridge the industry-academia skill gap.
It recommends promoting Public-Private Partnership (PPP) models in higher education to enhance graduate employability across India.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Multiple Schemes for Women Safety, Higher Education and Entrepreneurship
bullets: Inaugurated the 'Police Didi (Abhaya Brigade)' initiative by flagging off 4,700 two-wheelers for women police personnel to enhance security around schools and colleges.
Launched the 'Mukhyamantri Balika PhD Fellowship' scheme providing Rs 10,000 monthly fellowship for 4 years to nearly 1,000 female research scholars.
Rolled out the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge Scheme' offering financial assistance ranging from Rs 50,000 to Rs 2 lakh to 2,100 women entrepreneurs.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Key Initiatives for Women's Empowerment and Safety
bullets: The Bihar government announced the 'Bihar Ki Beti Startup Challenge', providing seed funding between ₹50,000 and ₹2 lakh to promote female entrepreneurs in the state.
Launched the 'Chief Minister Girl Child PhD Fellowship' scheme to provide ₹10,000 per month for four years to 1,000 female doctoral scholars.
Rolled out the 'Police Didi' (Abhaya Brigade) safety initiative equipping female police teams with 4,700 scooters and motorcycles to safeguard female students around educational institutions.

bihar_news.title: Key Provisions of Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025
bullets: Bihar's Minister for Industries, Shreyasi Singh, highlighted key features of the Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy 2025 aimed at accelerating industrial development in the state.
The policy provides incentives such as virtually free land up to 10 acres for industrial projects generating employment for 1,000 individuals, along with interest subventions of up to Rs 40 crore.
Key benefits under the policy also include State GST (SGST) reimbursement and streamlined fast-track land allotment to reduce production lead times.
